%% Stellio cover letter template v1 — pdfLaTeX, single file, Overleaf-compatible.
%% Stellio fills the STELLIO:SLOT markers. Edit layout here; content behaviour in rules/cover-letter.md.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage[a4paper,margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage{charter}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\usepackage{xcolor}
% pdfTeX only (Tectonic/XeTeX has no \pdfgentounicode and emits a Unicode text layer natively)
\ifdefined\pdfgentounicode\input{glyphtounicode}\pdfgentounicode=1\fi

\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{1F2A37}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{8pt}

% \letterHeader{Name}{Location}{Email}{Phone}{LinkedIn URL}
\newcommand{\letterHeader}[5]{%
  {\Large\color{accent}#1}\\[2pt]
  \small #2 \,|\, \href{mailto:#3}{\detokenize{#3}} \,|\, #4 \,|\, \href{#5}{LinkedIn}\normalsize\par\vspace{10pt}}
% \letterRecipient{Date}{Company}{Role / Team}{Location}
\newcommand{\letterRecipient}[4]{#1\par\vspace{2pt}#2\\#3\\#4\par\vspace{6pt}}

\begin{document}

%% STELLIO:SLOT header
\letterHeader{Firstname Lastname}{City, Country}{name@example.com}{+00 000 000000}{https://linkedin.com/in/example}
%% STELLIO:END header

%% STELLIO:SLOT recipient
\letterRecipient{19 November 2026}{Company}{Hiring Team, Job Title}{City, Country}
%% STELLIO:END recipient

%% STELLIO:SLOT body
Dear Hiring Team,

Opening paragraph.

Evidence paragraph.

Closing paragraph.
%% STELLIO:END body

%% STELLIO:SLOT closing
Kind regards,\\[14pt]
Firstname Lastname
%% STELLIO:END closing

\end{document}
